jira.name: get_issue
jira.description: Read a Jira work item: summary, description, status, labels and recent comments.

issue_key.description: Work item key, for example AIPF-12

jira.name: add_comment
jira.description: Add a plain-text comment to a Jira work item.

jira.name: transition
jira.description: Move a Jira work item to another status by the status name, for example "In Review".

codecommit.name: create_pull_request
codecommit.description: Open a pull request in the project repository from a branch into main. Returns its ID and link.

source_branch.description: Branch with the changes, already pushed

codecommit.name: get_pull_request
codecommit.description: Read a pull request: title, description, status, source and destination branches and commits.

codecommit.name: post_comment
codecommit.description: Comment on a pull request, on the whole change or on one line of one file.

file_path.description: Optional: file the comment is about

line.description: Optional: line number in the changed file

memory.name: read
memory.description: Read the project memory: notes and decisions earlier sessions and people recorded. Without a path, lists the notes.

path.description: Optional: note to read, for example decisions.md

memory.name: propose
memory.description: Propose a new or changed project memory note. A person reviews proposals before they become memory.

content.description: Full proposed content of the note

slack.name: ask_human
slack.description: Ask a person a question when the work item is unclear or needs a decision you must not take. The session should end after asking; it is restarted with the answer.

question.description: The question, with the context a person needs to answer it
